instruction:
RF daughtercard shield-can and inspection scene. The desktop contains `/home/user/Desktop/board_input.kicad_pcb`, `/home/user/Desktop/mechanical_requirements.json`, `/home/user/Desktop/connector_keepouts.csv`, `/home/user/Desktop/enclosure_seed.scad`, and `/home/user/Desktop/handoff_notes.md`. The handoff notes are supplementary and cannot override the KiCad board, requirements JSON, or connector CSV. KiCad-derived JSON, CSV, and SCAD handoffs may be generated by a deterministic parser within the KiCad stage; kicad-cli must also successfully load and export the board before OpenSCAD consumes those handoffs, but no particular helper script name or ordering between those KiCad-stage operations is required. Run the CLI handoff in this order: KiCad -> OpenSCAD -> FreeCAD -> Blender. Use the KiCad board for the board outline, thickness, footprint centers, mounting axes, component heights, and keepout radii; use the requirements for installed placement, package/shield geometry, protected volume, clearances, tolerances, and materials; each component_bodies.bbox_mm tuple is ordered [x, y, z]; use the connector CSV for access type, direction, and finished dimensions.

Use the PCB outline center as XY origin and the package bottom outer face as Z=0. Build the specified 84.4 x 60.4 x 12.2 mm covering ABS-ESD package, seat the PCB bottom at Z=3.2 mm on four bored standoffs aligned to MH1-MH4, and keep at least 4 mm PCB-to-inner-wall clearance away from accesses. Build a real installed closed-top RF shield centered on U1. The shield must remain a distinct installed solid with no positive-volume overlap with the package, so shield geometry and mass can be audited separately; shared boundary faces are allowed. The complete U1 KiCad keepout cylinder must lie inside the protected volume defined by the requirements; the complete J1 keepout cylinder must have zero intersection and positive separation from that protected volume. J1 must remain externally accessible through a bounded X_PLUS side window, J2 through a bounded X_MINUS side window, and TP1 through a continuous Z_PLUS lid bore, all using the CSV finished dimensions, requirements overcut, and minimum guard. Calculate package and shield volume/mass, side clearance, U1 containment, J1 protected-volume intersection/separation, each access continuity, and unintended interference from submitted geometry. In Blender, preserve real package/shield/PCB/component objects; visibly distinguish the protected volume, U1 inclusion, J1 exclusion, J2 window, and TP1 bore; save a native scene and render a review image.

Produce every required artifact directly on the desktop:
- `01_kicad_board.kicad_pcb`
- `01_kicad_board.step`
- `01_kicad_export.json`
- `01_kicad_mechanical_map.csv`
- `01_kicad_parameters.scad`
- `02_openscad_enclosure.scad`
- `02_openscad_enclosure.stl`
- `02_openscad_parameters.json`
- `03_freecad_assembly.step`
- `03_freecad_assembly.obj`
- `03_freecad_clearance_report.json`
- `04_blender_review.blend`
- `04_blender_review.obj`
- `04_blender_review.mtl`
- `04_blender_review.png`
- `04_blender_scene_report.json`
- `toolchain_invocation_log.json`
- `final_release_package.json`

The files must follow this sequence: KiCad must load the board and export the board STEP while deriving the CSV/JSON/SCAD handoffs; OpenSCAD must consume the KiCad-derived parameter handoff and render the submitted STL; FreeCAD must consume the KiCad STEP, OpenSCAD STL, and parameters, then export a real solid STEP assembly and OBJ; Blender must consume the FreeCAD OBJ/report and save, export, and render the review. The FreeCAD report must include geometry-derived `enclosure_volume_mm3`, `enclosure_mass_g`, `shield_volume_mm3`, `shield_mass_g`, `minimum_side_clearance_mm`, `u1_keepout_contained`, `j1_protected_volume_intersection_mm3`, `j1_protected_volume_separation_mm`, `access_checks`, `unintended_interference_volume_mm3`, and `decision`. Extra fields and artifacts are allowed. Tool retries and auxiliary calls are allowed, but the productive KiCad -> OpenSCAD -> FreeCAD -> Blender sequence and versions must be recorded. The final package must include every required artifact and may only report pass when geometry-derived checks pass. [Software] Use `kicad-cli` or KiCad scripting, `openscad`, `FreeCADCmd`/`freecadcmd`, and `blender --background --python` in that order. Use `/usr/bin/kicad-cli`, `/usr/bin/openscad`, `/home/user/.local/bin/freecadcmd`, and `/snap/bin/blender` for the four stages, in that order.
